title: The Hideaway and Fats Domino
summary: He and Fats Domino worked small bands at the Hideaway before Domino was discovered; location lost to the Desire Project.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Cabarets, honky-tonks and the Storyville nightlife scene

blocks.x: Dave, you once mentioned you were playing in a place, and Francis Domino was playing in the same place before he was discovered, before he made a hit. Tell me about this, where was this place?
Well, they called it The Hideaway.
Yeah, Fat had a band and I was there, a band, had two bands.
How many, how big were the bands?

Two of them small bands, like four or five people. Yeah. And Fat and I were working in the same place, just working. Yeah. And one night, fella come through there, I wasn't working. I'd say I'd probably been just as lucky as Fat, you know, if I'd been there. And made Fat been made ever since.
The Hideaway was back, oh, way back in the Night War, there, they read that, that, uh, uh, on Louisa, back on the wheels around Pida.
Uh, way back on the wheels around Pida.
Is that around the, is that across the canal? Yeah.
Across the Florida Canal? That, that, that's, uh.
Yeah, that's, uh. Across Florida Mall. Yeah, that's Florida, North Florida Mall? Yeah. All that cross there, that, that's where they got the, uh, they call it the Desire Project now.
Yeah. They ripped all that out?
Right, that's how they tore it down, because they would, they built the Desire Project. That's how the people had to, you know, get rid of their nightclubs.
